symptom: The research-only Runtime Decision Ledger validator used Set iteration for required-field presence and Set.prototype.has for allowed fields, decision, evaluation mode and completeness. A Node 22.16.0 synthetic Set.has=true plus empty Set iterator can bypass both membership and enum checks; source-equivalent malformed metadata becomes admitted. This is not a production or private-evidence incident.
lesson: A correct ledger schema does not enforce required fields or enum membership if the validator depends on mutable Set.prototype iteration and has. An ambient no-op iterator and always-true has can turn missing or unsupported metadata into an apparently valid research record.
guardrail: Use module-owned literal arrays with explicit indexed loops for required-field checks and scalar membership, not Set.prototype.has or Symbol.iterator. Preserve normal canonical digests; test invalid enum values, unknown fields and missing required fields under reversible synthetic Set hooks, and require direct digest entry to reject invalid records. This is research-only validation and grants no external source authentication or production authority.
